## Deliberately safe by construction

<!--
NEGATIVE AND POSITIVE CONTROL FOR tools/viewport-preflight.mjs

WHY this file exists. A gate that has only ever seen passing input is not a gate.
This fixture renders through the same quarto invocation, the same three stylesheets,
the same footer and logo and the same 1280x720 canvas as the real deck. Slide 2 is
built to be comfortably clear of the boundary and slide 3 is built to overflow it.

The gate is run against it with --expect-fail 3, which passes only when the flagged
set is exactly {3}. That fails loudly in both directions, if the gate stops
detecting overflow and if it starts flagging content that fits.

The block height on slide 3 is expressed in slide-local pixels so the control does
not depend on font metrics or on anything the real deck may later change.

The include shortcode on slide 2 and the logo in the front matter are here so the
fixture's render closure contains an embedded image and an included partial, the two
classes the staleness guard was blind to before. The selftest edits each of them and
requires a refusal.

Keep any prose comment INSIDE a slide. Markdown ahead of the first heading becomes
its own untitled slide and shifts every number this fixture asserts.
-->

This slide holds two short lines and nothing else.

Its content bottom sits far above the footer band, so the gate must not flag it.

{{< include fixture-partial.html >}}

## Deliberately overfilled by construction
